approach: Add crates/athena-core/src/context_load.rs, which measures context compression per class of work. For each class with at least 3 landed jobs it reports tokens loaded per landed job (input + cache_read + cache_write via Quantity::best_lower, counted over every invocation of the class's closed jobs, divided by its landed jobs). Beside that it reports the share of closed jobs that landed and the class's mistake count from status::mistake_report. A pure analyze() mirrors class_trend::analyze; ContextLoad::compute(&Records) feeds it from Records::all_invocations(). A thin class prints nothing, and no qualifying class gives None, so a thin history never reads as success. Register the module in lib.rs. Add ("context", "context_load") to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, a StatusView field context_load, and a context_section in display.rs. Name the mechanism and a measure ending `status: context` in docs/spec.toml. Tests: a core integration test (exact figures, thin class, spec entry) and a cli test that drives the real `athena status` text. CHANGELOG.md and an appended D175 record the change. Two files outside the reading's deliverables are kept, each because a gate or a criterion needs it: xtask/shard-timings.txt (two lines) and crates/athena-cli/tests/status_context.rs. The reasons are in the decisions.

decisions.choice: Cost is tokens loaded per LANDED job: the numerator counts the tokens of all the class's closed jobs (landed, rejected, failed, timed out); the denominator is its landed jobs.
decisions.reason: Compression that cuts tokens by losing outcomes must show up. Failed work's tokens are charged to the landed jobs, and the landed share and mistakes sit beside the figure, as the requirement says. This mirrors how status/throughput.rs charges time on non-landed jobs.

rejected.option: Mean tokens of landed jobs only
rejected.why: Hides the cost of failed attempts, so a cheaper class that fails more would look better.
That is the fixed per-role budget D25 already enforces; it says nothing about what a class of work loaded across a job.

decisions.choice: Tokens loaded = input + cache_read + cache_write, each via Quantity::best_lower(). Output tokens are excluded.
decisions.reason: Those three are what the model took in as context (Tokens in athena-data records, invocation.rs tokens_lower_bound). best_lower is the value, else the lower bound, else 0, so a killed invocation counts as the least it loaded.

rejected.why: Output is what the model wrote, not context loaded; it blurs the compression goal.
With prompt caching most loaded context shows as cache_read or cache_write, so input alone understates it.

decisions.choice: Read Records::all_invocations() and attribute each invocation by its job field to a classed, closed request job.
decisions.reason: The system facts and the all_invocations doc (store.rs:519-524) say a usage measure reads that iterator. The core test includes an auditor run tagged to a job to show it is counted. An invocation whose job is not a classed closed request job is attributed to no class.

rejected.why: Partial source by the store's own comment; it would miss steward, audience and auditor runs tagged to a job.

decisions.choice: Minimum of 3 landed jobs per class (MIN_LANDED_JOBS). A class below it prints no line, and no class qualifying gives None.
decisions.reason: Matches class_trend's thin-history rule (MIN_CLASS_JOBS) and the no-empty-success default.

rejected.option: Print every class with a 'thin' note
rejected.why: A figure from 1 or 2 jobs reads like a result.

decisions.choice: Mistakes come from status::mistake_report(records).by_class. Landed share is landed divided by closed jobs. No new quality judgement.
decisions.reason: Reuses the printed `mistakes` measure, so the two lines cannot disagree on what a mistake is.

rejected.why: Out of scope; the accepted reading says outcomes held means landed share and mistakes.

decisions.choice: Keep crates/athena-cli/tests/status_context.rs as a new cli test file, outside the reading's deliverable list (answers finding 3).
decisions.reason: Criterion 4 needs the real `athena status` text with and without data. StatusView has no Default or builder: it is built only at status.rs:1285, and display.rs's mod tests (display.rs:2046) have no way to build one. The nearest deliverable file, display.rs, therefore cannot host that test. The fixture pattern is status_role_need.rs:118-196. The file adds only a test and no behavior.

rejected.option: Unit-test only a context_section helper inside display.rs
rejected.why: It cannot show the line is absent from `athena status` when data is missing, which is the no-empty-success check.

rejected.option: Append the test to the existing status_role_need.rs
rejected.why: It edits an unrelated existing test file, which is wider than a new file with its own name.

decisions.choice: Edit xtask/shard-timings.txt by adding exactly two lines, one for each new test target (answers finding 4).
decisions.reason: The deliverable tests/context_compression.rs is a new test target. xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411-421 asserts the timings file lists exactly the workspace's test units, so `cargo test --locked` fails without the line. The cli target adds the second line. The line form is `athena-core --test context_compression 5.00`, matching existing lines such as `athena-cli --test budgets 8.00`.

rejected.why: Criterion 5 (cargo test passes) would fail on checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit.

steps: Read class_trend.rs (the shape to mirror), status.rs lines 305-323, 462 and 1285-1320, display.rs lines 1103 and 1353, and status_role_need.rs, before editing.

Create crates/athena-core/src/context_load.rs. Module doc: what is measured (input + cache_read + cache_write via Quantity::best_lower, output excluded), the minimum, and that a thin history prints nothing. Define MIN_LANDED_JOBS: usize = 3, ClassJob {id, class, landed, tokens}, ClassLoad {class, closed_jobs, landed_jobs, tokens, tokens_per_landed_job, landed_percent, mistakes} (derive Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize) and ContextLoad {classes}. analyze(&[ClassJob], &BTreeMap<String, usize>) -> Option<ContextLoad> groups by class in a BTreeMap, keeps a class only when landed jobs >= MIN_LANDED_JOBS, and fills mistakes from the map (0 if absent). compute(records) takes records.request_jobs() in a closed state (Landed, Rejected, Failed, TimedOut) with a class from j.class(), and sums records.all_invocations() per job id into that job's tokens. A job with no attributed invocation is left out because it did no model work. Mistakes come from crate::status::mistake_report(records).by_class. lines() gives a header plus one line per class in the form `docs: 1200 tokens per landed job · 3 of 4 closed jobs landed (75%) · 2 mistake(s)` (tokens {:.0}, percent {:.0}). Add unit tests: two classes grouped, a class under the minimum dropped, no class gives None, a lower-bound quantity counts as its lower bound, and the lines() text.
Register `pub mod context_load;` in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs after class_trend.

In status.rs: add the label to STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, the context_load field with its doc comment and skip_serializing_if, and `context_load: crate::context_load::ContextLoad::compute(&records)` in the StatusView literal.
In display.rs: add context_section(&ContextLoad) -> String and call it after the trend block when v.context_load is Some. Keep the literal `"context     {line}"` so the label scan finds `"context `.

Create crates/athena-core/tests/context_compression.rs (fixtures and expected numbers as in demonstration 3, plus the content test of demonstration 1) and crates/athena-cli/tests/status_context.rs (demonstration 4, with seed, invocation, outcome and job_record helpers copied from status_role_need.rs and status.rs). Run each behavior test once against a stub that returns None to confirm it fails, then restore the real code.

Edit xtask/shard-timings.txt (add `athena-core --test context_compression 5.00` and `athena-cli --test status_context 8.00` in the file's sorted position), docs/spec.toml (OLY-B-A13-01 mechanism and measure only), CHANGELOG.md (one bullet at the top of `### Added`), and append D175 to docs/decisions.md with Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost and Provenance (Read: the files above; Measured: the new tests; Not measured: figures on real records, and whether a smaller context holds outcomes). Edit nothing else in decisions.md or records/.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, then separately `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`, and fix any failure.

risks.risk: The cli fixture may reject or ignore a seeded Job record, so class() stays None and no line prints.
risks.mitigation: Step 6 copies job_record field-for-field from status.rs:1900-1932 and writes it at its canonical_path(). If the load rejects it, the producer seeds a Reading with class_of_work instead (JobRecords::class() falls back to the latest reading, store.rs:165-170). The core integration test does not depend on the fixture.

risks.risk: Tokens loaded mixes measured and lower-bound quantities (a killed invocation records a lower bound), so a figure can understate the load.
risks.mitigation: The header line says the figures are tokens of the recorded invocations, and D175 states the limit. A unit test pins best_lower behavior for a lower-bound quantity.

risks.risk: A class with 3 landed jobs of very different sizes gives a mean dominated by one big job.
risks.mitigation: Accepted and stated in D175 as a tradeoff: an exact mean is explainable and testable, while a median would hide the failed jobs' tokens. The landed share and mistakes appear beside it.

risks.risk: Class names on interventions and on jobs may differ, so the mistake count reads 0 for a class that had mistakes.
risks.mitigation: Classes are a closed list in configuration (D42), and mistake_report is the same source as the printed `mistakes` line. The tests use one name for both, and D175 notes the limit.

risks.risk: The two new test targets fail the xtask timings test if their lines are missing or misordered.
risks.mitigation: Step 7 adds both lines, and criterion 5 runs the full cargo test --locked, which includes ci_shards.

demonstrations.method: Three tests in crates/athena-core/tests/context_compression.rs, using only public API. (a) tokens_per_landed_job_and_outcomes_are_exact_for_two_classes builds Records::default(), inserts JobRecords (pub fields, Default derive, as in role_need.rs tests) with job: Some(Job{class_of_work,..}), invocations and an outcome, adds Records.interventions, and calls ContextLoad::compute(&records). Every invocation has output = 5000 so the output exclusion is tested. docs: d1 landed 400 (two invocations, 350+50), d2 landed 900 plus an auditor run tagged to d2 in records.auditor_runs of 100, d3 landed 1600, d4 failed 600. Expected for docs: closed 4, landed 3, tokens 3600, 1200.0 per landed job, share 75%, mistakes 2 (two Mistake interventions counted, one CorrectedOutput not). Expected for code: c1..c3 landed 2000, 3000, 4000, so 3000.0 per landed job, share 100%, mistakes 0. It also asserts the lines() text `docs: 1200 tokens per landed job · 3 of 4 closed jobs landed (75%) · 2 mistake(s)`. (b) a_class_below_the_minimum_yields_no_figure: a `config` class with 2 landed jobs is absent from classes, and records holding only that class give None. (c) the_spec_entry_is_not_a_gap_and_none_makes_it_one: as spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism (learnings_recorded.rs:311-318), the real entry is absent from spec_gaps and a copy with mechanism `none` yields a gap for OLY-B-A13-01. Expected numbers are written from the constants, not computed by the code.
demonstrations.observes: Exact figures 1200.0 and 3000.0, shares 75% and 100%, mistakes 2 and 0, no `config` class, no gap for the real entry, and a gap for the `none` copy.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the module the file does not compile. If compute read only jobs[..].invocations, docs would be 3500/3 and the 1200.0 assertion fails. If output tokens were counted, every figure changes. If the minimum were not enforced, `config` would appear. With the mechanism left `none` in the real spec, the spec test fails.

demonstrations.method: New test status_prints_the_context_line_only_when_a_class_has_enough_landed_jobs in crates/athena-cli/tests/status_context.rs, following status_role_need.rs:118-196. Phase 1: a fresh Fixture, `athena.status()`, then athena_cli::display::status(&view) has no line starting `context`. Phase 2: seed 2 landed docs jobs (a Job record with class_of_work `docs`, invocations, a Landed outcome) and commit; still no `context` line, since a thin history is not success. Phase 3: seed a third landed docs job and a fourth failed one (landed 400, 900 and 1600, failed 600, output 5000 each); the text has a line starting `context` containing `docs: 1200 tokens per landed job · 3 of 4 closed jobs landed (75%)`. It also checks that serde_json::to_value(&view) has `context_load` only in phase 3. Expected values come from the seeded constants.
demonstrations.observes: No `context` line in phases 1 and 2; the exact line in phase 3; the JSON key present only in phase 3.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the StatusView field or the printing code there is no `context` line in phase 3. Without the minimum, phase 2 prints a line. Without all_invocations, phase 3's figure is off.
